auth.tallerCreado: Request sent. Your workshop stays "pending" until the administrator approves it; then you can log in here.
google.error.rol: That email belongs to a workshop or administrator. Log in with your email and password.
cli.sinAlertas: All good: you have no upcoming maintenance.

cli.sinTalleres: There are no approved workshops in the system yet.

adm.descripcion: From here you approve the workshops that sign up and define which services can be recorded and which ones trigger alerts.
titulo.ingreso: Log in or sign up · AutoLog
nav.comoClienteDesc: I own a motorcycle or a car
ini.titulo: Your vehicle's whole maintenance history, in one place
ini.descripcion: Register your motorcycle or car, authorize the workshops you trust and let them record every service. We let you know when the next maintenance is coming up based on mileage.
ini.perfilesDesc: The app has three kinds of users. Find yours to see what you can do and where to start.
ini.clienteDesc: For anyone with a motorcycle or car who wants an organized history.
ini.cliente1: Register your vehicles and their mileage.
ini.cliente2: Choose which workshops can see and update each vehicle.
ini.cliente3: Get alerts when a service is coming up.
ini.cliente4: Download the history as a PDF.
ini.tallerDesc: For workshops that want to keep a record of the services they do.
ini.taller1: Find by plate the vehicles that authorized you.
ini.taller2: Record each service with its cost and mileage.
ini.taller3: Your account is activated once the administrator approves it.
ini.adminDesc: Keeps the system running well. This account already exists; it is not registered.
ini.admin2: Manages the service catalog and its alerts.
ini.comoDesc: Four steps to keep your vehicle's history up to date.
ini.paso1Desc: With your email or your Google account.
ini.paso2Desc: Plate, make, model, year and current mileage.
ini.paso3Desc: Only the workshops you choose can see it and record services.
ini.paso4Desc: We warn you before the next service and you can download the PDF.
ini.galeriaTitulo: We look after what moves you
ini.galeriaDesc: Motorcycles, cars and the workshops that keep them in good shape.
ini.finalDesc: Creating an account takes less than a minute.
ing.titulo: Log in or create your account
ing.descripcion: Pick a tab: "Log in" if you already have an account, or one of the sign-up tabs if you are new.
ing.ayudaLogin: Enter the email and password you signed up with. We will take you to your panel according to your account type (customer, workshop or administrator).
ing.googleNota: Google login is for customers only.
ing.clienteQuien: This option is for motorcycle or car owners.
ing.clienteAyuda: With your account you can register your vehicles, authorize the workshops that service them, get maintenance alerts and download the history as a PDF. The account is active right away.
ing.ayudaCorreo: You will use it to log in.
ing.tallerQuien: This option is for repair workshops.
ing.tallerAyuda: With your account you can find by plate the vehicles whose owners authorized your workshop and record the services you do.
ing.tallerPendiente: Important: after signing up, the administrator must approve your workshop. Until then you cannot log in.
cli.descripcion: Here you keep track of your vehicles and their maintenance.
cli.guia1: Add your vehicle with the "Add vehicle" button.
cli.guia2: Click "View details" and check the workshops that can service it.
cli.guia3: Keep the mileage up to date to get timely alerts, and download the history whenever you need it.
cli.alertasAyuda: We warn you when a vehicle is close to the mileage of its next service. They update when you or a workshop record new mileage.
cli.vehiculosAyuda: Click "View details" on a vehicle to see its history, update mileage or authorize workshops.
cli.sinVehiculos: You haven't registered any vehicles yet. Click "Add vehicle" to register your first one.
cli.eliminarNota: You can only delete a vehicle that has no maintenance records yet.
cli.kmAyuda: Enter what the odometer shows today. It cannot be lower than the last recorded value.
cli.kmGuardado: Mileage updated. Your alerts were checked against the new value.
cli.historialAyuda: Services recorded by the authorized workshops appear here, newest first.
cli.vehiculoCreado: Vehicle added. Now click "View details" to authorize a workshop.
cli.modalCrearAyuda: Fill in the details as they appear on the registration card. Check them carefully: afterwards you can only update the mileage.
cli.placaAyuda: No spaces or dashes. Car: ABC123 · Motorcycle: ABC12D.
cli.kmCrearAyuda: What the odometer shows today. Later you can only increase it.
tal.descripcion: Here you record the services you do on your customers' vehicles. You can only see vehicles whose owners authorized your workshop.
tal.guia1: Type the vehicle's plate and click "Search".
tal.guia2: Fill in the "Record maintenance" form with the service you did.
tal.guia3: Check the history; you can correct cost and notes on your own records.
tal.buscarAyuda: If the vehicle does not show up, ask the owner to authorize your workshop from their panel.
tal.sinResultado: Search a plate to see the vehicle, record maintenance and check its history.
tal.registrarAyuda: When you save, the vehicle's mileage is updated and the owner may get an alert for the next service.
tal.servicioAyuda: Only services that apply to this vehicle type are listed.
tal.kmAyuda: Equal to or higher than the last recorded.
tal.phObs: e.g. 20W-50 oil used. Check brakes at next service.
tal.historialAyuda: The "Edit" button only appears on records made by your workshop.
tal.editarAyuda: Only cost and notes can be corrected. If the service or mileage is wrong, record a new one.
adm.talleresAyuda: New workshops arrive as "Pending" and cannot log in until you approve them. If you deactivate a workshop, it loses access.
adm.sinTalleres: No workshop has signed up yet.
adm.catalogoAyuda: These are the service types workshops can record. A periodic service (like an oil change) triggers alerts every so many km. Deactivate a service so it can no longer be used.
adm.sinServicios: The catalog is empty. Click "New service" to create the first one.
adm.modalAyuda: Fields marked optional can be left blank.
adm.tipoAyuda: Defines on which vehicles workshops can record this service.
adm.periodicoAyuda: Check it if the service repeats every so many km; the system will then warn the customer.
adm.intervaloAyuda: How many km between services. e.g. 5000
adm.margenAyuda: How many km in advance to warn. e.g. 500
nav.swaggerAyuda: Interactive documentation of the web services
